root_cause_explanation: F20 classified contract qualified based solely on rule creation and rule.region != None without invoking model.adaptiveRemesh(odb). F21 called model.adaptiveRemesh(odb) on the identical model state. Abaqus adaptiveRemesh scanned the assembly for active geometry faces/cells bound to remeshing rules, found only orphan mesh instance PART-1-1, and raised AbaqusException: The model contains no adaptive regions for remeshing. The existence of a RemeshingRule in model.remeshingRules does not constitute a recognized adaptive region.
